---
title: "check-equation-labels.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags a display equation
with no `{#eq-...}` label.
The lab labels every display equation,
so that each one is numbered and has a stable URL,
as the display-equation section of ai-config's `AGENTS.md` asks.
The `equation-anchors` filter adds a permalink only to a labeled equation,
so an unlabeled one has no anchor to link to.
It moves the repo-local check that
[Morrison-Lab/ids#201](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/ids/pull/201) added,
when it labeled all 215 of that repository's display equations.

Quarto reads the label from the line of the closing `$$`:

```markdown
$$
H(X) = -\sum_x p(x) \log p(x)
$$ {#eq-entropy}
```

The label may share its attribute block with other attributes,
as in `{#eq-entropy .unnumbered}`.

The check does not count `$$` inside a code fence, a code span,
or an HTML comment, and a backslash escapes a `$`.
A raw LaTeX environment such as `\begin{equation}`
is not a display equation here,
since Quarto numbers only `$$` math.
A `$$` that opens no equation ends at the next blank line,
as Pandoc ends display math there,
so a stray delimiter does not swallow the rest of the file.

`<!-- check-equation-labels: allow: <reason> -->`
on the equation's opening line, or on the line before it, exempts it.
A pragma with no reason exempts nothing.

## Scope

Only an equation that holds a line a pull request adds is reported,
from its opening `$$` through its closing one,
so existing equations are never reflagged.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new,
so labeling one equation does not flag its unlabeled neighbor.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
to measure a corpus,
or to keep a fully labeled repository fully labeled,
as ids does.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`     | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`        | Fail the workflow when a display equation has no label. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, [whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-equation-labels.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a $$ ... $$ display equation with no {#eq-...}
# label when a PR adds a line to it, since only a labeled equation gets a
# number and an anchor. Put a label after the closing $$, such as
# $$ ... $$ {#eq-entropy}, or add
# <!-- check-equation-labels: allow: reason --> on the line before it.
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check equation labels

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-equation-labels.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                        # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every file; use once every equation is labeled
```

See
[`examples/check-equation-labels.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-equation-labels.yml)
for the full caller stub.
